question: Are there exactly 10 prime numbers between 3,383 and 3,482 inclusive?

claims.text: There are exactly 12 primes between 3,383 and 3,482 inclusive.
The claim of exactly 10 primes is false.
Since 60² exceeds 3482, a number in the range is prime exactly when no prime up to 59 divides it.
Checking 29, 31, 37 and 53 removed no further numbers.
The listed 12 numbers (3389 through 3469) are all prime.
No trial division left a prime that would need to be discarded to bring the count down to 10.
The sieve by primes up to √3482 is conclusive.
